scenario: Restore 28 explicit/materialized October 30 general assessments for channels and segments only

method.baseline: Current App.jsx Q3_OVERLAYS through buildDdiPeriodProducts with backlog-data ready; includes ELK MAU Nov11.
method.counterfactual: Apply only 28 historical general facts to the final runtime result. Preserve all other current rules and scores; no full historical app rollback, no recomputation of unrelated derived values.
method.teamDdi: Existing completeProductPercent: applicable scored index metric points / applicable maxima, rounded to integer. Null/incomplete teams excluded from dashboard averages.
method.overallDdi: DashboardPage: arithmetic mean of rounded team DDI for scored teams, then rounded to integer. meanOfRounded exposes the sub-point movement; meanOfRaw is supplementary.
method.levels: Existing maturityLevelName of rounded score: <40 attention, 40–60 developing, 61–80 mature, >80 leader.
exclusions: General values without an explicit selected Oct30 fact
method.caveat: Three channel Navigator values are materialized user-confirmed rules (ELK market, SBOL/Notifications MAU), rather than direct answer rows. Included as original October30 assessments. Latest ELK MAU November11 remains 100%.
